# hyperlite_node (Data Source)

A node of the Hyperlite cluster, to place resources on it. `local` is the node the provider talks to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_node" "node2" {
  name = "node2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The node's name, or `local`.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The address Hyperlite reaches it at.
- `id` (String) The node's name.
- `member` (Boolean) A member of the cluster (it runs Hyperlite), not a node driven over SSH only.
- `status` (String) `online`, `offline` or `unknown`.
